cases.disposition_reason: showcase --page readonlyreport opens Read-only report in src/bin/showcase/pages/readonly_report.rs. The Copy report button calls cx.copy_as, Request::Copy reaches Shell::copy_at in src/bin/showcase/app.rs and src/shell/app.rs, and Clipboard::report in src/shell/clipboard.rs paints Copied the report (13 lines). The process is still running. finish then sends Ctrl+Q and the process exits 0.
cases.entry_path: showcase --page readonlyreport --color truecolor --motion reduced, then the Copy report button
cases.return_path: The copied status stays on Read-only report, then finish sends Ctrl+Q and the process exits 0

cases.disposition_reason: QuitKeys::classify in src/ui/leave.rs returns LeaveKey::Copy when KeyContext.selection is set and LeaveKey::Quit otherwise, while ctrl_c is on. src/shell/router.rs treats that selection as the focused ring's has_selection. With a selection it skips quit and the page handles the key. With no selection, Ctrl+C requests quit before page_key. Showcase Read-only report, tablepro connections, and holla --scenario parity-files each exit 0 on Ctrl+C when nothing is selected. A data-grid range sets the ring through ctx.selection in src/widgets/grid.rs. After shift+right on Northwind Traders, Ctrl+C leaves the process running and src/bin/showcase/pages/grid.rs paints Copied N chars, not Not copied. Tablepro history y calls copy_as(sql, "query") in src/bin/tablepro/workbench.rs through Request::Copy in src/bin/tablepro/app.rs. After the history scope is all connections, the status is Copied query and the process stays running. Holla Copy this folder's path is Launch::Copy in src/bin/holla/domain/catalog.rs and goes through copy_osc52 in src/bin/holla/app.rs. parity-files sets osc52_limit to 64 in src/bin/holla/domain/parity.rs and leaves osc52 on. The folder path encodes under that limit, so the status is Copied to the terminal clipboard (OSC 52, flushed) · /Users/alex/work/notes. The 71-byte cloud-only.txt path encodes to 96 bytes, so y reports Not copied · 96 encoded bytes exceed the terminal's 64 byte OSC 52 limit and does not report Copied. parity-platforms-linux sets osc52 false. The same folder action reports Not copied · this terminal does not accept OSC 52 · no system clipboard is wired and does not contain a Copied line. Jackin sets clipboard write to false in src/bin/jackin/app.rs. y on the launch-failure dialog reports Copied 21 characters · run-202609030914-b5df. layer_key consumes Ctrl+C while that dialog is open, so the process stays on Launch failed. OSC 52 bytes are queued only when Clipboard.write is true in src/shell/clipboard.rs. tests/functional/support.rs does not expose that side channel, and the cell snapshot does not include OSC. This case does not call take_output and does not claim a host pasteboard change. Holla copy_osc52 and jackin set write to false, so they do not emit OSC even when the status mentions OSC 52. The checkpoint is showcase --page readonlyreport after Copy report, still running, with Copied the report (13 lines) visible. The 80×24 frame is the same session after resize and before the return to 120×40. finish then sends Ctrl+Q.
cases.action_sequence: Ctrl+C with no selection on showcase Read-only report, tablepro connections, and holla parity-files. Shift-select a data-grid cell and press Ctrl+C. Copy a tablepro history query with y. Copy this folder's path under parity-files and parity-platforms-linux. Copy the 71-byte cloud-only.txt path under parity-files. Copy the jackin launch-failure run id with y, then press Ctrl+C. Click Copy report, capture 120×40, resize to 80×24, capture that frame, resize back, then finish.
cases.expected_results: A consumed copy leaves the process running and paints its copy report. Ctrl+C with nothing consuming it exits 0. The checkpoint shows Copied the report (13 lines) at 120×40 and at 80×24.
cases.forbidden_effects: An unsupported or oversized clipboard path is reported as a copied payload. When osc52 is false the screen contains Not copied and does not contain a Copied line.
